supported_conclusion: As of 2026-08-31, the official dashboard reports 500 MW nameplate and 420 MW usable capacity. The 460 MW news figure was published later than its 2026-07-31 data date, is older than the dashboard snapshot, and uses an undefined available-capacity label.
unsupported_conclusions: Nameplate and usable capacity are interchangeable.
The news figure is based on 2026-08-25 data.
